query:
SELECT 
  s.name as student_name,
  s.venue,
  s.scheduleDay,
  s.scheduleTime,
  s.feePerQuarter,
  d.coach_name
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN dojos d ON (
  s.venue = d.name AND
  s.scheduleDay = d.schedule_day AND
  s.scheduleTime = d.schedule_time
)
LIMIT 10;
